gameDescriptionHtml:
Fish Game is the de-fin-itive freshwater fishkeeping sim experience made *for* enthusiasts *by* enthusiasts. Featuring fish with personalities and dynamic relationships, water quality modeling, plants that grow and much more! Made with support from Destin and our friends at “Smarter Every Day”!

Game Features

  • Over 130 types of Fish with distinct personalities and behavioral quirks, leading to infinite, evolving and dynamic relationships with complex hierarchies.
  • A wide variety of behaviors, including schooling, chasing, fighting, and even carnivorous behavior.
  • Propagating aquatic plants (50 species) for you to adopt and raise.
  • Over 50 types of rocks, driftwood, and novelty hardscape, including setpieces from some of your favorite games!
  • 25 types of fully sculptable substrate, layer-able and in a variety of colors.
  • Comprehensive hunger and food systems, with 11 types of food for herbivores, omnivores and carnivores, whether they’re grazers, opportunists or predators.
  • Unlockable content and mechanics via fishkeeper XP. Upgrade Tanks from 7 to 3000 gallons, upgrade shops for rarer critters, and more.
  • An economy-free shopping experience focused more on discovering rare treasures–no grinding for currency!
  • Simulated carbon dioxide, ammonia, and oxygen levels that have intricate relationships with your fish, plants, algae, light levels, and more.
  • A relaxing “No Death Mode”. Put a living, breathing aquarium on your TV with Steam Link!
  • Photo Mode: take great pictures and set up fantastic dolly shots to share with your friends and participate in community contests.
  • Playable on Steam Deck!

Included DLCs:

  • Free Fish Pack
  • Asia Fish Pack 1
  • India Fish Pack 1
  • Indonesia Fish Pack 1
  • Substrate DLC
  • Betta Fish Pack 1
